text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If we traveled from here to here...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You can earn this many miles?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then... what if we change the starting 
point, and go way, way further east...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no! Like, what if we take a 
layover and end up going to that country 
instead?!"

She stayed up all night, calculating every 
possible way to rack up miles...
